notes: Runtime captures, not renders, at 960d427 (after merging #132, so About your rivals has its Close calls row). The switch was set through the fixture (-ScreenshotStreakReminder), not tapped (no tap access from the agent); the binding is covered by NotificationsScreenTests. The tap capture feeds a streak-reminder response through the notification delegate's own route (-ScreenshotNotificationResponse with -ScreenshotNotificationKind streakReminder); no notification was shown or tapped, since relay alert pushes can't reach the Simulator without a real APNs token. The reminder's payload and copy are pinned by relay/test/streakReminder.test.ts. The open iPhone Duo and accessibility text sizes were not captured.
